overall_summary: Data clearly shows that husband-wife relationships and marriage dynamics massively outperform generic shayari or family member spotlights, generating over 1,600+ views compared to the baseline 100-300 views. Content focusing on mature relationship realities has strong repeatable potential.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,767 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,674 views) heavily outperform all other content categories.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marriage, couple dynamics, and long-term relationship emotional compromises.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a relatable psychological or emotional question about everyday life ('Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota', 386 views) perform better than generic statements.
winning_patterns.action: Use curious, thought-provoking questions as video titles and opening lines.

weak_patterns.pattern: Generic One-Sided Shayari / Deep Sad Poetry
weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 19 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly poetic, or overly dramatic dialogues; stick to grounded, everyday relationship observations.

next_video.emotion: नस्टैल्जिया और अकेलापन (Nostalgia and silent distance)
next_video.hook_style: Question-based real-life observation about how couples stop talking over time
next_video.concept: A couple sitting in the same room for hours without speaking a single word, scrolling on phones, realizing the silence between them has grown louder than their conversations.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with the simple sound of phone notifications in a quiet room at night, followed by the text on screen: 'शुरुआत में घंटों बातें खत्म नहीं होती थीं, आज एक ही कमरे में रहकर भी दिनभर बात नहीं होती।'
next_video.twist_direction: The realization hits that they aren't fighting anymore—they have just stopped caring enough to fight, which is much more painful.
next_video.reason: Aligns directly with the highest-performing winning pattern (husband-wife relationship dynamics) while exploring emotional detachment rather than outright conflict.

experiment: Testing if subtle emotional detachment in marriage performs as well as direct relationship advice and questions.
